caption: The image depicts a decorative plate featuring a central scene bordered by an ornate rim. The central illustration shows a round, domed neoclassical building with columns, surrounded by trees and a fence. In front of the building, there is a horse-drawn wagon with a covered top; the wagon is being led by several horses and accompanied by a person. There is also an arched structure with a statue or figure to the right of the building. The rim of the plate is decorated with a repetitive pattern of large oak leaves and acorns, marked by detailed shading and stippling. The entire design is rendered in grayscale, exhibiting variations of black, white, and gray tones. The composition centers on the building and wagon, with the ornate border providing a contrasting frame of natural motifs.
title: Plate - Waterworks, Philadelphia
